editorial.blurb: Alegrias brings vibrant seafood energy with generous, shareable platters that celebrate bold Mexican-inspired flavors and warm hospitality.
editorial.insiderTip: Dine in to enjoy the fried whole fish fresh, and arrive ready to share—the Charola Mixta and garlicky shrimp & octopus platters are meant for groups. It's BYOB, so bring your favorite beer or tequila.
